name: Eleanor M.
text: The most beautiful sky I have ever seen. Our guide knew every dune by name and the camp was genuinely luxurious. We didn't want to leave.

name: Thomas & Léa
text: We did the Grand Crossing and it felt like stepping off the edge of the world. Five days of absolute silence and gold.

name: Yuki T.
text: As a solo traveler I was nervous, but the team made me feel completely safe and included. The stargazing night was unforgettable.
